title: The Maharashtra Keeping and Movement of Cattle in Urban Areas (Control) Act, 1976
full_text: The Maharashtra Keeping and Movement of Cattle in Urban Areas (Control) Act, 1976 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197645 Act Number: 45 Enactment Date: 1976-09-20 Act Year: 1976 Short Title: The Maharashtra Keeping and Movement of Cattle in Urban Areas (Control) Act, 1976 Long Title: An Act to provide, in the public interest, for licensing and regulating or prohibiting, keeping and movement of cattle in urban areas in the State of Maharashtra. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Urban Development Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1. SCHEDULE Order Appendix Forms TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles The Maharashtra Keeping and Movement of Cattle in Urban Areas (Control) Act, 1976 Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Cattle not to be kept in urban areas without licence. Section 4. Two classes of licences. Section 5. Issue and renewal of licences. Section 6. Power to suspend or cancel licences. Section 7. Prohibition of import of cattle into urban areas. Section 8. Appeals. Section 9. Orders of Licensing Officer and Appellate Authority to be final. Section 10. Prohibited areas for keeping cattle. Section 11. Power to enter and inspect premises. Section 12. Power to take bond to produce cattle before Magistrate. Section 13. Offences and penalties. Section 14. Offences by companies. Section 15. Special provision regarding sentence of fine. Section 16. Power to try offences summarily. Section 17. Protection of action taken in good faith. Section 18. Rules. Section 19. Exemptions. Section 20. Act to have overriding effect, but shall be in addition to existing local authority laws. Section 21. Repeal and savings. Schedule 1.
